limits: Path assignments are not read proofs. Unresolved uses remain explicit; a separate reachable read proof may justify that same path, but no blanket copying follows. Caller/fixture reachability is static and tied to actual collected IDs, not execution. Three V1 gzip inputs are whole archive reads; caption .py.txt baselines are parsed as data. Vocabulary source URLs are checked strings, not fetched. Root owns content_history and its dynamic maps. Runtime, imports, Git and environment behavior remain outside this named read closure.
scope: Source-only metadata AST, JSON and source-specific read proofs. No application imports, collection, tests, copying, compilation or source/data changes. No full-run readiness or copying approval.
